accepted.title: Control your home using British Sign Language through your camera
accepted.summary: This feature allows you to sign to a connected camera to turn on lights, adjust the heating, or ask questions. It makes the smart home fully accessible for BSL users without requiring voice commands or touch screens.

accepted.title: See British Sign Language video responses on your dashboard
accepted.summary: When you check the weather or ask your home a question, your dashboard will show a high-quality animation signing the answer. This ensures you receive important household information directly in your primary language.
